Never put 0.0.0.0/0 UDR or NSG on GatewaySubnet!

UDR 0.0.0.0/0 -> Internet; SNAT Never for RFC 1918 + 100.64/10

Max 16 BGP peers, 4,000 routes/peer; rejects AS_PATH w/ 65515
No NSG or UDR allowed on RouteServerSubnet.
Receives inspected return SYN-ACK via AFW
With RouteTableEnabled/Enabled, UDR mask >= VNet mask
